            "path_or_url": "wiki/Architecture.md",
            "section": "Architecture > Project documentation storage and isolation",
            "snippet": "Project documentation storage is organized as a derived, project-scoped index\nof repository-owned files. Each project identity receives isolated SQLite index\nstate and extracted artifacts, so one repository's project docs cannot satisfy\nanother repository's query. The filesystem documents remain authoritative; the\nindex is a rebuildable cache coordinated by the writer lease and cleanup barrier\ndescribed in [Index cleanup](../docs/index-cleanup.md).",
            "version_binding": "unversioned",
            "content_sha256": "c8c735ed372b01120403671017caff692a4201e4863dac96a044591fd2d1b669",
            "project_identity": "local:27d872ab18831ec1e77b918507e22b6ae14268419231cc28c35c1bc550dca546",

          {
            "evidence_id": "ev-c2eddc6ad062a61d",
            "path_or_url": "wiki/Architecture.md",
            "section": "Architecture > Per-library index isolation",
            "snippet": "Each library+version has its own independent SQLite index. The `LibraryDocsService._index_config_for` method creates a separate database under `~/.docatlas/docs-indexes/<normalized_name>.db` and a separate extracted directory. This prevents cross-library contamination, enables independent refresh/recreate per target, and keeps the global `docatlas.db` registry lightweight (metadata only).",
